class.name: TickNetwork
class.brief_description: Tick based network: server authority, client prediction and interpolation.
class.description: Synchronizes the [TickObject] nodes over a [TickTransport], in fixed ticks. The peer with id 1 is the server: it simulates every object, moving each one with the input of its controller. A client predicts the objects it controls and rewinds them when the server disagrees; the other objects are interpolated [member interpolation_delay] seconds behind the server. The network ticks during the physics process; set [member ticks_per_second] equal to [member ProjectSettings.physics/common/physics_ticks_per_second], so bodies moved with the physics delta (like [method CharacterBody3D.move_and_slide]) advance one tick at a time. The client uses the server's tick rate. The client's clock is synchronized with the server's, and the client runs ahead of the server just enough for its inputs to arrive in time, adapting its speed to the network conditions.

method.name: get_frame
method.description: Returns the next frame to simulate. Clients run ahead of the server.

method.name: get_local_peer_id
method.description: Returns the id of this peer in the transport, or 0 when not running.

method.name: get_rtt
method.description: Returns the round trip time to the server, in seconds, as measured by the clock synchronization (client only).

method.name: get_stats
method.description: Returns a [Dictionary] with statistics: [code]rewinds[/code], [code]rewound_frames[/code], [code]ghost_inputs[/code] (inputs repeated by the server because they were missing), [code]late_inputs[/code], [code]rejected_inputs[/code], [code]full_snapshots_sent[/code], [code]delta_snapshots_sent[/code], [code]snapshots_received[/code], [code]snapshots_dropped[/code], [code]malformed_packets[/code] and [code]time_scale[/code] (the client's speed adjustment).

method.name: get_transport
method.description: Returns the transport passed to [method start].

method.name: is_predicting
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] on a client once its clock is synchronized and it predicts its objects.

method.name: is_rewinding
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while a client simulates again past frames after a correction. Use it to skip side effects (sounds, particles) during the rewind.

method.name: is_server
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this peer is the server.

method.name: start
method.description: Starts the network over [param transport]. The peer with id 1 becomes the server; the others are clients and join when connected to it.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops the network. The objects stay registered and synchronize again on the next [method start].

members.member: Frames of history kept for snapshots, predictions and interpolation.
Number of past inputs repeated in each input packet, against packet loss.
How far behind the server, in seconds, the interpolated objects are rendered.
Largest number of inputs the client tries to keep buffered on the server.
Smallest number of inputs the client tries to keep buffered on the server; more jitter increases it up to [member max_input_buffer].
Node the paths of the objects are relative to. The same object must have the same path on every peer.
The server sends a snapshot every [member snapshot_interval] ticks.
Ticks per second of the simulation. Clients use the server's value.

signal.name: peer_left
signal.description: Emitted when a client leaves (on the server) or when the connection with the server is lost (on a client).

signal.name: peer_ready
signal.description: Emitted on the server when a client passes the handshake, and on a client when the server accepts it ([param peer] is 1).

signal.name: prediction_started
signal.description: Emitted on a client when its clock is synchronized and it starts predicting its objects.

signal.name: rejected
signal.description: Emitted on a client when the server refuses it, for example because of a different protocol version or precision build.

signal.name: rewound
signal.description: Emitted on a client after a rewind: the predicted objects diverged from the server at [param frame], and [param frame_count] frames were simulated again.
